name: CM-2 Arana cluster missile
description: A CM-2 Arana cluster missile was a model of cluster missile that could be launched from a starship and could lock onto multiple targets. Upgrading an EML-850 light freighter previously equipped with M-72 concussion missiles to CM-2 Arana missiles cost two thousand credits and required a X-FP-C28 ship computer, twenty units of quadanium steel, and eight enhanced durasteel hulls.
